name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Bluegill, Crappie, and Trout go with Mabel, 14 lb, and 18 lb, in some order.
Exactly one of these is true: Gus goes with 12 lb; Perch goes with 18 lb; Perch goes with 20 lb.
If both Dale does not go with 12 lb and Carp goes with 16 lb, then Perch goes with Gus.
The angler who landed the Trout's weight is lower than both Boone and Gus.
Dale's weight is higher than both Mabel and the angler who landed the Trout.
Either Crappie goes with Boone or someone in the Sunfish Family goes with Boone (but not both).
Either 14 lb goes with Carp or Crappie goes with 18 lb.
If 14 lb goes with Bluegill, then the catch with 16 lb does not belong to the Pike Family.
